result.description: A fictional 27-inch monochrome e-ink display designed for ultra-low-power document review, ambient dashboards, and quiet workspace use. The Orchid Veil 27Q emphasizes paper-like readability, wide viewing angles, and a flicker-free front-light system rather than gaming or high-refresh performance. It uses a matte anti-glare panel, USB-C video input, and a minimalist chassis intended for desks, libraries, and studio environments.
